summary: The agent failed because the bundled compute_metrics.py only accepts CSV input, but the task provided an Excel (.xlsx) file. The agent wrote a custom script that produced JSON with wrong schema keys (e.g., primary_date_range instead of primary_analysis_window, total_records instead of total_records_in_source, points as array instead of integer). Updated the bundled script to support both CSV and Excel inputs while preserving exact verifier-compliant output schema. Reinforced SKILL.md with Excel handling guidance and schema compliance reminders.
